pageDescription: Manage all application properties and settings from one place
saveError: An error occurred while updating the settings

companyInfo.title: Basic Company Information
companyInfo.description: This data appears on official invoices and reports.
companyInfo.addressPlaceholder: Address details to appear on invoices

businessRules.title: Locale and Business Rules
businessRules.description: Rules that control the behavior of the product table and its form.
businessRules.currencyHelpNoDecimals: This currency determines the number of decimal places shown for all monetary amounts in the system — no decimal places.
businessRules.currencyHelpWithDecimals: This currency determines the number of decimal places shown for all monetary amounts in the system — {{count}} decimal place(s).
businessRules.rowColorHighlightLabel: Highlight expired or low-stock product rows
businessRules.rowColorHighlightDescription: When enabled, expired product rows are highlighted red and out-of-stock rows orange
businessRules.scientificNameVisibleLabel: Show scientific name field in product form
businessRules.scientificNameVisibleDescription: When disabled, the "scientific name" field is fully hidden from the add/edit form
businessRules.scientificNameRequiredDescription: When enabled, a product cannot be saved without entering a scientific name

sales.title: Sales Behavior
sales.description: Rules controlling stock, customer, and permissions while creating and editing sales invoices.
sales.allowZeroStockLabel: Allow selling products with zero stock
sales.allowZeroStockDescription: When disabled, a product with zero stock cannot be added to a sale invoice.
sales.allowNegativeStockDescription: When enabled, a sale can exceed the quantity actually available in stock.
sales.requireCustomerLabel: Require selecting a customer for sales
sales.requireCustomerDescription: When enabled, a sale cannot be completed without selecting a registered customer.
sales.defaultCustomerHelp: The customer automatically selected when opening a new sale.
sales.allowPriceEditDescription: When disabled, the sale price field in the invoice is locked to the product's default price.
sales.allowInvoiceDateEditDescription: When disabled, every invoice is recorded with its actual creation date and time, with no way to change it.

pos.title: Point of Sale (POS) Settings
pos.description: Control the behavior of the point-of-sale screen and its notifications.
pos.showExpiredDescription: When enabled, expired products will appear in POS search results.
pos.showOutOfStockDescription: When enabled, products with zero or negative stock will appear in POS search results.
pos.paymentMethodsHelp: At least one payment method must remain active.
pos.usdEnabledDescription: When disabled, the exchange-rate button is hidden from the top bar, and USD-priced products are shown/sold at their raw value without multiplying by the exchange rate.
pos.whatsappNumbersLabel: Numbers to receive the shift closure report
pos.whatsappNumbersHelp: Type a phone number then press "Add" or Enter to add it to the list. It must include the country code without +
pos.firebaseCollectionHelp: The Firestore collection name where products and shifts are stored.

purchases.title: Purchase Settings
purchases.description: Control the default currency and item fields for purchase invoices.
purchases.defaultCurrencyHelp: This currency will be used as the default when creating a new purchase invoice.
purchases.useBatchNumberDescription: When enabled, a batch number column appears in the purchase items table and can be entered for each item.
purchases.useExpiryDateDescription: When enabled, an expiry date column appears in the purchase items table and can be set for each item.

pdf.title: Invoice Branding
pdf.description: Upload the company logo, stamp, and signature, and choose where the logo appears on printed invoices and reports.
pdf.stampSignatureHelp: The stamp and signature images appear on invoices and reports that support these elements.
